name: Snatch and Grab
summary: Master Mathias Shaw sends agents to Jerod's Landing for shipping intelligence. The Defias Brotherhood uses the river dock to move supplies in secret.

sections.title: A Test of Tradecraft
sections.body: Master Mathias Shaw tests aspiring operatives who seek a place in Stormwind's covert intelligence wing. He asks for finesse and stealth, not brute force. SI:7 agents take down key figures quietly and recover important papers without drawing the realm into open scandal. Each new operative must prove they can work unseen.

sections.title: Smugglers on the River
sections.body: Jerod's Landing lies on the river in southern Elwynn, south of Goldshire and just east of the Maclure Vineyards. The Defias Brotherhood seized the once-quiet dock and made it an illicit route. Smuggled arms, supplies, and contraband cross the water from Redridge toward Westfall, beyond the reach of royal road patrols.

sections.title: Plausible Deniability
sections.body: Master Mathias Shaw warns agents that capture, compromise, or death leaves them without the Crown's support. Stormwind and its spymasters will deny knowing they ever existed. Recovering the Defias Dockmaster's schedule gives SI:7 proof of the Brotherhood's supply lines while keeping Stormwind's official involvement hidden.

faq.q: Who assigns the quest Snatch and Grab?
faq.answer: Master Mathias Shaw, leader of Stormwind's intelligence service SI:7, assigns the work from its headquarters in Old Town.
Jerod's Landing is a river dock in southern Elwynn Forest, south of Goldshire and just east of the Maclure Vineyards. The Defias Brotherhood has taken control of the docks and dock house.

faq.q: What are the Defias smuggling through Jerod's Landing?
faq.answer: The Defias move contraband and supplies across the water between Redridge and Westfall, beyond kingdom watchposts and road checkpoints.

faq.q: Who carries the Defias Shipping Schedule?
faq.answer: The Defias Dockmaster carries the shipping schedule and guards the dock house at Jerod's Landing.

faq.q: What happens if an operative is captured during this mission?
faq.answer: Master Mathias Shaw warns that SI:7 will deny any connection to an operative who is exposed or captured.

faq.q: Why does SI:7 care about this shipping schedule?
faq.answer: The schedule details how the Defias Brotherhood moves contraband between Redridge and Westfall. It lets Stormwind's intelligence network map the enemy's supply lines without alerting the syndicate.

angles.text: As a rogue, you are introduced to SI:7 and tested in stealth and cutpurse instincts. Earn Mathias Shaw's recognition and a signature blade.
As an Alliance member, you help intercept Defias supply lines at Jerod's Landing, protecting Elwynn Forest and weakening the criminal syndicate that threatens Stormwind's surrounding territories.
